Name: Alternate Clothes for Female Sebastian
Author: JohnnyGat12345
Description:
First and foremost, thank you to Adarin for creating these and allowing for me to modify them. Secondly, if at any moment he wishes for me to stop these, I will comply and stop working on them and simply use it in my own game instead. 

Hi guys! I've been a really big fan of Adarin's genderbent bachelors, though I thought that some of the expressions and clothing could be changed a bit more. While Adarin stays very true to what the characters originally were, I wanted to diverge a bit and make them a bit more fashionable. That having been said, I modified Adarin's portraits and sprites.

 So until I've finished then, I'll be happy to share some of the progress I get through!
